tweets.body:
This one is really powerful when you get it right: giving your coding agent access to external devices lets it do much more than just write code.

For a mobile app I’m building, I connected two old phones to my coding agent. It can control them, test new features immediately after building them, see what happens, and close the feedback loop itself.

tweets.title:
General-purpose harnesses are compromises.

Instead of one giant harness for every task, build custom harnesses for each meaningful part of the agent workflow.
tweets.body:
General-purpose harnesses are compromises.

Instead of one giant harness for every task, build custom harnesses for each meaningful part of the agent workflow.

Specialized harnesses can make the same model perform far better on a specific task. Benchmarks already show this.
